# Mutants no test can catch, since the program still does just what it did, at most slower.
# `.github/scripts/mutants-equivalent.sh` takes them out of what a run missed. Each entry is four
# lines, with a blank line after:
# - the file;
# - what cargo-mutants says the mutant does, after the line and column;
# - text on the line it changes, so the entry goes with the line as code above it moves, and a
#   line that's changed is a missed mutant again, to be looked at afresh;
# - why it changes nothing.
#
# Add one only when no program could tell the difference. A mutant that only a wrong program
# could show is a missing test, not an equivalent.

[] => dict == object,
Only which lookup's entry a put tries: `put_found_in_place` uses it only after checking at run time that the lookup searched this very block, and searches again otherwise.
